ex.en: A famous architect built this house.
ex.zh: 這棟房子是一位知名建築師蓋的。

ex.en: That building's facade is bizarre. No idea what the architect was thinking.
ex.zh: 那棟大樓的外觀很怪，不知道建築師在想什麼。

ex.en: He's an architect.
ex.zh: 他是建築師。

ex.en: She was the architect of the company's new strategy.
ex.zh: 她是公司新策略的規劃者。

ex.en: He is known as the architect of the peace agreement.
ex.zh: 他被稱為這份和平協議的推手。

architect.en: the person who plans and creates an idea or system

ex.en: The building is an architectural masterpiece.
ex.zh: 這棟建築是建築界的傑作。

ex.en: She studies architectural design in college.
ex.zh: 她在大學念建築設計。

architectural.en: relating to the design of buildings

ex.en: He was raised in an artistic family.
ex.zh: 他在藝術世家長大。

ex.en: In addition, she has an artistic flair.
ex.zh: 此外，她也很有藝術天分。

ex.en: My father is far from artistic.
ex.zh: 我爸爸一點藝術細胞也沒有。

artistic.en: relating to art, or good at making art

ex.en: The ball flew through the air in a high arc.
ex.zh: 球在空中劃出一道高高的弧線。

ex.en: The chairs were arranged in an arc around the stage.
ex.zh: 椅子沿著舞台排成弧形。

arc.en: a curved line or shape like part of a circle

ex.en: The story arc of the series is very well written.
ex.zh: 這部影集的故事主線寫得很好。

ex.en: Each character in the novel has a clear arc.
ex.zh: 小說中每個角色都有清楚的成長轉變。

arc.en: the way a story or character changes over time

ex.en: Traders use arbitrage to profit from price differences.
ex.zh: 交易員利用套利從價差中獲利。

ex.en: Currency arbitrage requires fast and accurate data.
ex.zh: 外匯套利需要快速又準確的資料。

arbitrage.en: buying and selling at once in different markets to make money from price differences

ex.en: Behind every animal on the Chinese zodiac lies an array of proverbs, sayings and stories.
ex.zh: 每個生肖背後都有一大堆成語、俗語和故事。

ex.en: The store offers a wide array of products.
ex.zh: 這家店提供各式各樣的商品。

array.en: a large and varied group of things

ex.en: Store the values in an array.
ex.zh: 把這些值存到陣列裡。

ex.en: The array contains ten elements.
ex.zh: 這個陣列有十個元素。

array.en: a list of items stored together in a computer program

ex.en: She is arguably the best player on the team.
ex.zh: 她可以說是隊上最好的球員。

ex.en: This is arguably the most important decision of the year.
ex.zh: 這可說是今年最重要的決定。

arguably.en: used when you can give good reasons for what you say

ex.en: Today our artificial satellites are revolving around the earth.
ex.zh: 現在我們的人造衛星正環繞地球運行。

ex.en: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
ex.zh: 人造皮革比不上真皮。

ex.en: She held a large bouquet of artificial flowers in her hands.
ex.zh: 她手裡拿著一大束假花。

ex.en: Her smile seemed artificial.
ex.zh: 她的笑容看起來很做作。

ex.en: The meeting had a polite but artificial atmosphere.
ex.zh: 會議的氣氛客氣但很不自然。

ex.en: Artificial intelligence is changing many industries.
ex.zh: 人工智慧正在改變許多產業。

ex.en: The company uses artificial intelligence to answer customer questions.
ex.zh: 這家公司用人工智慧回答客戶的問題。

artificial.en: computer systems that can do things that normally need human thinking

ex.en: My mother prefers the arbitrary selection of the lottery machines over my lucky numbers.
ex.zh: 比起我的幸運號碼，我媽寧願讓彩券機隨機選號。

ex.en: The decision seemed arbitrary and unfair.
ex.zh: 這個決定看起來很武斷又不公平。

ex.en: Choose an arbitrary number between one and ten.
ex.zh: 從一到十之間隨便選一個數字。

arbitrary.en: decided by chance or personal wish, not by a reason or rule

ex.en: The dispute was settled through arbitration.
ex.zh: 這起糾紛透過仲裁解決了。

ex.en: Both sides agreed to go to arbitration.
ex.zh: 雙方同意交付仲裁。

arbitration.en: the settling of a disagreement by an independent person chosen by both sides

ex.en: The girl had a long scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 女孩的脖子上圍著一條長圍巾。

ex.en: Today our artificial satellites are revolving around the earth.
ex.zh: 如今我們的人造衛星正繞著地球運行。

around.en: on all sides of something, or in a circle about it

ex.en: The temperature of the human body hovers around 37°C.
ex.zh: 人體溫度大約維持在攝氏37度左右。

ex.en: The meeting will end around five.
ex.zh: 會議大約五點結束。

around.en: used to show that a number is close but not exact

ex.en: Spaniards love to stroll around in the evening cool.
ex.zh: 西班牙人喜歡在傍晚涼爽時出外散步。

ex.en: We walked around the night market.
ex.zh: 我們在夜市到處逛。

around.en: in many places or in different directions

ex.en: Is there a bank around here?
ex.zh: 這附近有銀行嗎？

ex.en: Is Tom around?
ex.zh: 湯姆在嗎？

ex.en: His name is known to everybody in this area.
ex.zh: 這一帶的人都知道他的名字。

ex.en: Tom doesn't like people who smoke in no smoking areas.
ex.zh: 湯姆討厭在禁菸區抽菸的人。

ex.en: The Red Cross constantly supplies food to the disaster areas.
ex.zh: 紅十字會持續提供食物給災區。

area.en: a part of a town, country or the world

ex.en: The area of the factory is 1,000 square meters.
ex.zh: 工廠的面積是一千平方公尺。

ex.en: What is the area of this room?
ex.zh: 這個房間的面積是多少？

area.en: the size of a flat surface, measured in square units

ex.en: Her area of expertise is marketing.
ex.zh: 她的專業領域是行銷。

ex.en: Sorry, this is not my area.
ex.zh: 抱歉，這不是我的專長。

area.en: a subject or field of activity

ex.en: Had I arrived earlier, I could have seen Kelly.
ex.zh: 如果我早點到，就能見到凱莉了。

ex.en: The letter will arrive in a week or so.
ex.zh: 這封信大約一星期左右會到。

ex.en: I didn't tell anyone what time I'd be arriving.
ex.zh: 我沒告訴任何人我幾點會到。

arrive.en: to reach a place at the end of a trip

ex.en: After a long discussion, we arrived at a decision.
ex.zh: 經過長時間討論，我們做出了決定。

ex.en: How did you arrive at that number?
ex.zh: 你是怎麼算出那個數字的？

arrive.en: to reach a decision or an agreement after thinking or talking

ex.en: He stretched out his arm to take the book.
ex.zh: 他伸長手臂去拿書。

ex.en: Tom broke some bones in his arm and hand.
ex.zh: 湯姆的手臂和手斷了幾根骨頭。

ex.en: The baby was sound asleep in her mother's arms.
ex.zh: 嬰兒在媽媽懷裡睡得很熟。

arm.en: the part of the body between the shoulder and the hand

ex.en: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.
ex.zh: 軍隊占領了整片領土。

ex.en: He is armed to the teeth.
ex.zh: 他全副武裝。

ex.en: My comment sparked off an argument in the group.
ex.zh: 我的評論在小組裡引發了一場爭論。

ex.en: I saw Tom having an argument with Mary.
ex.zh: 我看到湯姆和瑪麗在吵架。

ex.en: I often have arguments with Tom.
ex.zh: 我常和湯姆吵架。

argument.en: an angry talk between people who disagree

ex.en: Tom was unable to refute Mary's arguments.
ex.zh: 湯姆無法反駁瑪麗的論點。

ex.en: Her argument was clear and convincing.
ex.zh: 她的論點清楚又有說服力。

argument.en: a set of reasons given to show that something is true or right

ex.en: I'll arrange for someone to pick you up at your home.
ex.zh: 我會安排人去你家接你。

ex.en: Can you arrange for a night tour bus?
ex.zh: 你能幫忙安排夜間觀光巴士嗎？

ex.en: In the afternoon I must arrange for the trip.
ex.zh: 下午我得安排旅行的事。

arrange.en: to plan and organize something so that it can happen

ex.en: Rocks are beautifully arranged in the Japanese-style garden.
ex.zh: 日式庭園裡的石頭排列得很美。

ex.en: My mother teaches flower arranging.
ex.zh: 我母親教插花。

arrange.en: to put things in a particular order or position

ex.en: Sam joined the army when he was eighteen.
ex.zh: 山姆十八歲時從軍。

ex.en: A great number of citizens went into the army.
ex.zh: 許多老百姓加入了軍隊。

ex.en: The town was defended by a large army.
ex.zh: 這座城市由一支大軍守衛。

army.en: a large group of soldiers who fight on land

ex.en: Arrangements have already been made.
ex.zh: 一切都已經安排好了。

ex.en: I'll make arrangements for your trip.
ex.zh: 我會幫你安排行程。

ex.en: We need to discuss the seating arrangements.
ex.zh: 我們需要討論座位安排。

arrangement.en: plans made so that something can happen

ex.en: We have an arrangement with a local supplier.
ex.zh: 我們和一家本地供應商有合作協議。

ex.en: They came to an arrangement about the payment.
ex.zh: 他們就付款方式達成了協議。

arrangement.en: an agreement between people about how to do something

arrangement.zh: 排列、布置（如 flower arrangement 插花）

ex.en: Flower arrangement is a part of Japanese culture.
ex.zh: 插花是日本文化的一部分。

ex.en: I love the flower arrangement on the table.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡桌上的插花。

arrangement.en: a group of things put in a particular order or pattern

ex.en: I didn't know Tom was going to be arrested.
ex.zh: 我不知道湯姆會被逮捕。

ex.en: On what grounds are you arresting me?
ex.zh: 你憑什麼逮捕我？

ex.en: Did the police arrest Tom?
ex.zh: 警察逮捕湯姆了嗎？

arrest.en: to take a person away because the police think they broke the law

ex.en: No arrests were ever made.
ex.zh: 始終沒有人被逮捕。

ex.en: The police made three arrests last night.
ex.zh: 警方昨晚逮捕了三個人。

ex.en: You are under arrest.
ex.zh: 你被逮捕了。

arrest.en: the act of the police taking a person away for a crime

ex.en: The accident arose from a simple mistake.
ex.zh: 這起事故是由一個簡單的錯誤引起的。

ex.en: A new difficulty has arisen.
ex.zh: 出現了新的困難。

ex.en: Please contact me if any problems arise.
ex.zh: 如果出現任何問題，請與我聯絡。

arise.en: to begin to happen or appear

ex.en: Rome is famous for its ancient architecture.
ex.zh: 羅馬以古代建築聞名。

ex.en: You like to talk about architecture, don't you?
ex.zh: 你喜歡談論建築，對吧？

ex.en: She studied architecture in Italy.
ex.zh: 她在義大利讀建築。

architecture.en: the art of designing buildings, or the style of a building

ex.en: Sixty-four-bit software will not run on 32-bit architecture.
ex.zh: 64 位元的軟體無法在 32 位元架構上執行。

ex.en: We need to redesign the system architecture.
ex.zh: 我們需要重新設計系統架構。

architecture.en: the basic design and structure of a computer system

ex.en: He shot an arrow at the deer.
ex.zh: 他朝那頭鹿射了一箭。

ex.en: The archer shot an arrow at the target.
ex.zh: 弓箭手朝標靶射了一箭。

arrow.en: a thin stick with a sharp point that is shot from a bow

ex.en: The arrow indicates the way to go.
ex.zh: 箭頭標示行進方向。

ex.en: Click the arrow to see the next photo.
ex.zh: 點箭頭就能看下一張照片。

arrow.en: a sign shaped like a line with a point, used to show direction

ex.en: The hotel lobby is full of local artwork.
ex.zh: 飯店大廳擺滿了在地藝術作品。

ex.en: This artwork was sold for a million dollars.
ex.zh: 這件藝術品以一百萬元售出。

artwork.en: paintings, drawings and other objects made by artists

ex.en: The artwork for the book cover is ready.
ex.zh: 書的封面插圖已經完成了。

ex.en: Please send us the final artwork by Friday.
ex.zh: 請在週五前把最終設計稿寄給我們。

artwork.en: pictures and designs prepared for a book or printed material

ex.en: Tom and Mary argue with each other all the time.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗總是在吵架。

ex.en: I argued with Yoko a little bit.
ex.zh: 我跟洋子吵了一下。

ex.en: It is no use arguing with him about it.
ex.zh: 跟他爭論這件事是沒用的。

argue.en: to speak angrily with someone who disagrees with you

ex.en: Columbus argued that he could reach India by going west.
ex.zh: 哥倫布主張往西航行可以到達印度。

ex.en: Some experts argue that the plan will not work.
ex.zh: 有些專家認為這個計畫行不通。

argue.en: to give reasons to show that something is true

ex.en: I couldn't put up with her arrogant behavior.
ex.zh: 我無法忍受她傲慢的態度。

ex.en: Mary is very arrogant, isn't she?
ex.zh: 瑪麗太驕傲了，不是嗎？

ex.en: Don't be so arrogant!
ex.zh: 別那麼傲慢。

arrogant.en: too proud of yourself and rude to others

ex.en: Blocked arteries can lead to a heart attack.
ex.zh: 動脈阻塞可能導致心臟病發作。

ex.en: The nurse pressed on the artery to stop the bleeding.
ex.zh: 護理師壓住動脈止血。

artery.en: a tube that carries blood from the heart to the body

ex.en: This road is the main artery into the city.
ex.zh: 這條路是進城的主要幹道。

ex.en: Traffic on the major arteries was heavy this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上各主要幹道的交通都很壅塞。

ex.en: The article on Buddhism revived my interest in oriental religions.
ex.zh: 那篇關於佛教的文章又燃起了我對東方宗教的興趣。

ex.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
ex.zh: 他剛發表了一系列有趣的文章。

ex.en: I've boldfaced the articles that I found interesting.
ex.zh: 我把覺得有趣的文章用粗體標出來了。

article.en: a piece of writing in a newspaper or magazine

ex.en: "A" and "the" are articles.
ex.zh: a 和 the 是冠詞。

ex.en: Many learners forget to use articles.
ex.zh: 很多學習者會忘記用冠詞。

article.en: a word such as a, an or the that is used before a noun

ex.en: Everyone was more or less interested in the arts.
ex.zh: 每個人多少都對藝術有點興趣。

ex.en: They awarded her first prize at the art exhibition.
ex.zh: 她在美術展中獲得首獎。

art.en: the making of things such as paintings and music, or the things made

ex.en: She took night classes in the art of self-defense.
ex.zh: 她上夜間課程學防身術。

ex.en: Cooking is an art.
ex.zh: 烹飪是一門藝術。

art.en: a skill that you can learn and get better at

ex.en: The poor young man finally became a great artist.
ex.zh: 這位窮困的年輕人最後成了偉大的藝術家。

ex.en: He is one of the greatest artists in Japan.
ex.zh: 他是日本最偉大的藝術家之一。

ex.en: She will be a famous artist in the future.
ex.zh: 她將來會是一個有名的藝術家。

artist.en: a person who makes paintings, drawings or other works of art

ex.en: Thousands of workers and artisans toiled for 22 years to create this breathtaking white marble structure.
ex.zh: 數千名工人和工匠辛勤工作了 22 年，才打造出這座令人驚歎的白色大理石建築。

ex.en: Farther from the palace and to its north and south were the commoners, merchants, artisans, and laborers.
ex.zh: 離皇宮較遠的南北兩邊，住的是平民、商人、工匠和勞工。

artisan.en: a person who makes things by hand with skill

ex.en: She studied archaeology at university.
ex.zh: 她大學念考古學。

ex.en: Archaeology helps us understand how people lived long ago.
ex.zh: 考古學幫助我們了解古人的生活。

archaeology.en: the study of the past by looking at old buildings and objects found in the ground

ex.en: The museum displays artifacts from ancient Egypt.
ex.zh: 博物館展出古埃及的文物。

ex.en: Archaeologists found many artifacts at the site.
ex.zh: 考古學家在遺址發現了許多文物。

artifact.en: an old object made by people, often of interest in history

ex.en: Japan is an archipelago of thousands of islands.
ex.zh: 日本是由數千座島嶼組成的群島。

ex.en: The Philippines is a large archipelago in Southeast Asia.
ex.zh: 菲律賓是東南亞的大群島。

ex.en: I created an archive of my emails.
ex.zh: 我把電子郵件都做了封存備份。

ex.en: I'm downloading this internet archive.
ex.zh: 我正在下載這份網路封存資料。

archive.en: a collection of records or files kept for the future

ex.en: Old emails are archived automatically after a year.
ex.zh: 舊郵件一年後會自動封存。

ex.en: Please archive these files at the end of the project.
ex.zh: 專案結束後請把這些檔案歸檔。

archive.en: to store records or files so that they can be kept for a long time

ex.en: The tenant paid three months of rent arrears.
ex.zh: 房客補繳了三個月的欠租。

ex.en: The supplier account is now two weeks in arrears.
ex.zh: 這家供應商的帳款目前已逾期兩週。

arrears.en: money that is owed and should have been paid earlier

ex.en: AI stands for artificial intelligence.
ex.zh: AI 是人工智慧的縮寫。

ex.en: Artificial intelligence helps analyze customer feedback.
ex.zh: 人工智慧有助於分析客戶回饋。

artificial intelligence.en: computer systems that can do things that normally need human thinking

ex.en: The aroma of freshly baked bread filled the lobby.
ex.zh: 新鮮出爐麵包的香氣瀰漫整個大廳。

ex.en: Roasting brings out the coffee"s rich aroma.
ex.zh: 烘焙能帶出咖啡濃郁的香氣。

ex.en: The precise time of their arrival is not known.
ex.zh: 他們到達的確切時間還不明。

ex.en: On his arrival at the station, he called a taxi.
ex.zh: 他到了火車站，就叫了輛計程車。

ex.en: What's the flight's scheduled arrival time?
ex.zh: 飛機預計幾點到？

arrival.en: the act of reaching a place

ex.en: With the arrival of winter, leaves fall from the trees.
ex.zh: 樹上的葉子隨著冬天的到來而掉落。

ex.en: The arrival of spring brings warmer weather.
ex.zh: 春天到來，天氣也跟著變暖了。

arrival.en: the time when something new begins or comes

ex.en: Sometimes he has difficulty being articulate about his views.
ex.zh: 他有時很難把自己的看法說清楚。

ex.en: She is an articulate speaker.
ex.zh: 她是一位口才很好的講者。

articulate.en: able to express ideas clearly and well in speech

ex.en: He found it hard to articulate his feelings.
ex.zh: 他覺得很難清楚說出自己的感受。

ex.en: Try to articulate your main point in one sentence.
ex.zh: 試著用一句話清楚說出你的重點。

articulate.en: to say or explain thoughts or feelings clearly

ex.en: The country has a strong armed force.
ex.zh: 這個國家擁有強大的武裝部隊。

ex.en: The guards were armed with simple tools.
ex.zh: 守衛們配備著簡單的工具。

ex.en: Thousands of fans filled the arena to watch the basketball game.
ex.zh: 數千名球迷擠滿了球場觀看籃球賽。

ex.en: The singer will perform at the new arena next month.
ex.zh: 這位歌手下個月會在新的表演場館演出。

ex.en: Education has become an important arena for public debate.
ex.zh: 教育已成為公共辯論的重要領域。

ex.en: The archbishop gave a speech at the ceremony.
ex.zh: 大主教在典禮上發表了談話。

ex.en: Thousands welcomed the archbishop to the city.
ex.zh: 數千人歡迎大主教來到這座城市。

ex.en: The strange noise aroused my curiosity.
ex.zh: 那個奇怪的聲音引起了我的好奇心。

ex.en: His speech aroused strong feelings in the crowd.
ex.zh: 他的演講在群眾中激起強烈的情緒。

ex.en: The alarm aroused him from a deep sleep.
ex.zh: 鬧鐘把他從沉睡中叫醒。

ex.en: She was aroused by the sound of the rain.
ex.zh: 她被雨聲吵醒了。

ex.en: We walked through a stone arch into the old town.
ex.zh: 我們穿過一道石拱門進入老城區。

ex.en: The bridge has three large arches over the river.
ex.zh: 這座橋在河上有三個大拱形橋孔。

ex.en: Flat shoes gave me pain in the arch of my foot.
ex.zh: 平底鞋讓我的足弓疼痛。

ex.en: Good insoles can support the arch and reduce tiredness.
ex.zh: 好的鞋墊能支撐足弓並減輕疲勞。

ex.en: The cat arched its back and stretched.
ex.zh: 貓咪拱起背伸了個懶腰。

ex.en: Tall trees arch over the quiet country road.
ex.zh: 高大的樹木在寧靜的鄉間小路上方形成拱形。

ex.en: The traveler met an Arab merchant at the market.

ex.en: The cafe attracts an arty crowd.
ex.zh: 這家咖啡館吸引了一群文藝氣息濃厚的客人。

ex.en: Arkansas is a state in the southern United States.
ex.zh: 阿肯色州是美國南部的一個州。

ex.en: The capital of Arkansas is Little Rock.
ex.zh: 阿肯色州的首府是小岩城。

ex.en: Some scholars study the ancient Aryan languages.
ex.zh: 有些學者研究古代雅利安人的語言。

ex.en: The book describes the Aryan migration into India.
ex.zh: 這本書描述了雅利安人遷入印度的過程。

ex.en: The archdiocese runs several schools and hospitals.
ex.zh: 這個總教區經營了好幾所學校和醫院。

ex.en: The archbishop leads the archdiocese.
ex.zh: 總主教領導這個總教區。

ariel.zh: 艾莉爾（人名；《小美人魚》主角的名字）

ex.en: Ariel is the name of the mermaid in a famous animated movie.
ex.zh: 艾莉爾是一部著名動畫電影裡人魚的名字。

ex.en: Ariel is also used as a given name for both girls and boys.
ex.zh: 艾莉爾也被用來當作男孩和女孩的名字。

ex.en: She uses aromatherapy to relax after a long day.
ex.zh: 她用芳香療法在漫長的一天後放鬆。

ex.en: The spa offers a massage with aromatherapy oils.
ex.zh: 這間水療館提供搭配芳療精油的按摩。

ex.en: She topped the pizza with fresh arugula.
ex.zh: 她在披薩上放了新鮮的芝麻菜。

ex.en: Arugula has a slightly bitter, peppery taste.
ex.zh: 芝麻菜帶有些微的苦味和胡椒味。

ex.en: He used artifice to get the guard to open the door.
ex.zh: 他用詭計讓守衛把門打開。

ex.en: The film's beauty comes from careful artifice, not luck.
ex.zh: 這部電影的美來自細心的巧妙安排，而不是運氣。

ex.en: He rested his arm on the armrest of the sofa.
ex.zh: 他把手臂靠在沙發的扶手上。

ex.en: The seat has a folding armrest between the two chairs.
ex.zh: 這排座椅之間有一個可折起的扶手。

ex.en: My grandfather's arthritic knees hurt when it rains.
ex.zh: 下雨時，我爺爺患關節炎的膝蓋會痛。

ex.en: She has arthritic hands and finds it hard to knit.
ex.zh: 她的手有關節炎，很難織毛線。

ex.en: She arranged a meeting for Monday morning.
ex.zh: 她安排了星期一早上的會議。

ex.en: We arranged to meet at the station.
ex.zh: 我們約好在車站碰面。

ex.en: He arranged the books by size on the shelf.
ex.zh: 他把書依大小排列在書架上。

ex.en: The flowers were beautifully arranged in a vase.
ex.zh: 花被漂亮地插在花瓶裡。

ex.en: She took up archery and hits the target almost every time.
ex.zh: 她開始學射箭，幾乎每次都能射中靶。

ex.en: Archery requires patience and a steady hand.
ex.zh: 射箭需要耐心和穩定的手。

ex.en: He gets argumentative whenever he is tired.
ex.zh: 他一累就愛跟人爭辯。

ex.en: Don't be so argumentative; just listen.
ex.zh: 別那麼愛爭論，聽聽就好。

ex.en: The course covers Aristotelian ideas about ethics.
ex.zh: 這門課探討亞里斯多德的倫理學觀點。

ex.en: Aristotelian logic influenced thinkers for centuries.
ex.zh: 亞里斯多德的邏輯影響了思想家好幾個世紀。

ex.en: The arroyo was dry for most of the year.
ex.zh: 那條旱溪一年中大部分時間都是乾的。

ex.en: After the storm, water rushed down the arroyo.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後，水沿著乾谷奔流而下。

ex.en: His arraignment is scheduled for Monday morning.
ex.zh: 他的提審排在週一早上。

ex.en: At the arraignment, the man pleaded not guilty.
ex.zh: 在提審時，該名男子表示不認罪。

ex.en: The archeologist carefully brushed dirt off the old pot.
ex.zh: 考古學家小心地刷掉古老陶罐上的泥土。

ex.en: An archeologist found coins buried near the temple.
ex.zh: 一位考古學家在寺廟附近發現了埋藏的錢幣。
